title: The Children's Crusade
summary: Young redcaps sworn to kill Seelie nobles.

claims.text: The Children's Crusade, made up mostly of redcap childlings and young wilders, has one aim: to assassinate as many Seelie nobles as it can.

It draws support from Anarchists and Repudiators and from some Modernists who see it as a way to raise commoner power; its killers are nearly always childlings, who weather the Banality of slaying other fae more easily.
